description: Shared coding-agent workflow, bounded command checks and startup validation. Review new/changed hooks in /hooks.

hooks.commandWindows: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $p=$null; $started=$false; $code=1; try { $text=New-Object System.Text.StringBuilder; $buffer=New-Object char[] 4096; while (($n=[Console]::In.Read($buffer,0,$buffer.Length)) -gt 0) { if ($text.Length+$n -gt 65536) { throw 'Hook input exceeds limit' }; [void]$text.Append($buffer,0,$n) }; $raw=$text.ToString(); if ([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetByteCount($raw) -gt 65536) { throw 'Hook input exceeds limit' }; $info=New-Object System.Diagnostics.ProcessStartInfo; $info.FileName='C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe'; $info.Arguments='"C:/Projects/qbo/scripts/agent-harness/continuation.cjs" prompt'; $info.UseShellExecute=$false; $info.CreateNoWindow=$true; $info.RedirectStandardInput=$true; $info.RedirectStandardOutput=$true; $info.RedirectStandardError=$true; $p=New-Object System.Diagnostics.Process; $p.StartInfo=$info; $started=$p.Start(); if (!$started) { throw 'Hook child did not start' }; $out=$p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(); $err=$p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(); $bytes=[Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($raw); $write=$p.StandardInput.BaseStream.WriteAsync($bytes,0,$bytes.Length); if (!$write.Wait(1000)) { throw 'Hook input delivery timed out' }; $p.StandardInput.Close(); if (!$p.WaitForExit(2000)) { throw 'Hook execution timed out' }; if (!$out.Wait(250) -or !$err.Wait(250)) { throw 'Hook output timed out' }; [Console]::Out.Write($out.Result); [Console]::Error.Write($err.Result); $code=$p.ExitCode; } catch { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Continuation hook launch failed: '+$_.Exception.Message) } finally { try { if ($started -and !$p.HasExited) { $p.Kill(); if (!$p.WaitForExit(500)) { $code=1; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Continuation hook child cleanup timed out') } } } catch { $code=1; [Console]::Error.WriteLine('Continuation hook child cleanup failed') } finally { if ($null -ne $p) { $p.Dispose() } } }; exit $code
